headword: {公共|こうきょう}{交通|こうつう}{機関|きかん}
reading: こうきょうこうつうきかん

definitions.explanation: Transportation systems available to the general public, including trains, buses, subways, and ferries. Japan is renowned for its extensive and reliable public transportation network.

examples.japanese: {公共|こうきょう}{交通|こうつう}{機関|きかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。

{公共|こうきょう}{交通|こうつう}{機関|きかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}できる→生活する：01839_seikatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Because public transportation is well-developed, you can live without a car.

examples.english: Due to the typhoon, public transportation was severely disrupted and many commuters were stranded.

notes:
{公共|こうきょう}{交通|こうつう}{機関|きかん} is the formal term for public transportation systems — trains, buses, subways, ferries, and other transit available to the general public.

FORMS:
⟦{公共|こうきょう}→公共：11652_koukyou⟧ (public) + ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧ (transportation) + ⟦{機関|きかん}→機関：02630_kikan⟧ (system/institution). In casual speech, ⟦{公共|こうきょう}{交通|こうつう}→公共交通：18130_koukyoukoutsuu⟧ alone is sometimes used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公共|こうきょう}{交通|こうつう}{機関|きかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to use public transportation
- {公共|こうきょう}{交通|こうつう}{機関|きかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: public transportation stops
- {公共|こうきょう}{交通|こうつう}{機関|きかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧: improvement of public transportation
- {公共|こうきょう}{交通|こうつう}{機関|きかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れる→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧: public transit is disrupted

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan is known for its extensive, punctual public transportation network. Disruptions due to ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧ (typhoons) or ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧ (earthquakes) are major news events.
